name: dev-kubectl-read-secrets
why: Control: reading Secrets, which the read-only use does not name.

job.purpose: read-only kubectl against the staging cluster: get/list/describe pods, deployments, events and read pod logs in namespace web

statements: allow read on pod in namespace "web" of cluster "staging"
allow read on pod log in namespace "web" of cluster "staging"
allow read on deployment in namespace "web" of cluster "staging"
allow read on event in namespace "web" of cluster "staging"

definitions.cluster: A Kubernetes cluster; "staging" is the one this credential reaches.
definitions.pod: A Kubernetes pod: get, list or describe it.
definitions.pod log: The log of a container of a Kubernetes pod.
